# Third-party browser libraries

This directory includes:

- TensorFlow.js 1.3.1, Copyright Google LLC and contributors.
- Teachable Machine Image library 0.8.3, Copyright Google LLC and contributors.

Both packages identify their license as Apache License 2.0. A copy is included as `APACHE-2.0.txt`. The vendored files are kept at their published npm/jsDelivr versions so the classifier page can run without internet access.
